## Lab Overview

Learn Python setup, basic programming concepts, functions, collections, and package imports.

## Topics Covered

- Python installation and VS Code setup
- Variables and data types
- Conditional statements
- For and while loops
- Functions and return values
- Lists, tuples, dictionaries, and sets
- Installing and importing Python libraries

## Learning Outcomes

- Understand basic Python syntax.
- Write conditional statements and loops.
- Create reusable functions.
- Work with Python collections.
- Install and import external packages.

## Tools and Technologies

Python, VS Code, NumPy, Pillow, Matplotlib
